lesson: Not a defect (0158): Decision 0158 section 2 states the observed value IS contextUsage.totalTokens when the run reports it, and modelVisibleInputTokens derived from normalised usage ONLY when it does not; the confirmed spec repeats it at docs/specs/cache-bug.md:73. The implementation follows that precedence exactly, and AGENTS.md makes docs/decisions authoritative over conflicting guidance, so inverting it would put the code in breach of an accepted decision. T2-AC1 does not require otherwise: its sentence describes the S4 errored-run case, where a run that died mid-turn has no contextUsage and the usage-derived figure is the only measurement available. It never forbids contextUsage; reading a prohibition into it is an inference rather than its text. AC1's second clause, that a run reporting no usage must not call the operation, is honoured — the mark resolves to undefined only when BOTH contextUsage and usage are absent, and the raise returns early on undefined, so the repository is never called without a measurement. An output carrying contextUsage HAS reported one. The reviewer's substantive worry, that a provider's own context snapshot could read lower than the cache-inclusive input count, is real but is the tradeoff 0158 section 2 weighed and accepted, on the grounds that the provider's snapshot is authoritative about its own context size; re-deciding it inside T2 would overturn an accepted decision through a review finding. For the record, AC1's wording is narrower than 0158 and invited this reading, which is a defect in the criterion I authored rather than in the code. — raised as "[P1] Require reported usage before raising the session mark (apps/core/src/runtime/group-agent-runner-context-ceiling.ts:49): `raiseProviderSessionMarkFromOutpu"
